arxiv-2010-08065.title: FPRaker: A Processing Element For Accelerating Neural Network Training
arxiv-2010-08065.creator: Omar Mohamed Awad 1 , Mostafa Mahmoud 1 , Isak Edo 1 , Ali Hadi Zadeh 1 , Ciaran Bannon 1 , Anand Jayarajan 1 Gennady Pekhimenko 1,2 , Andreas Moshovos 1,2 {omar.awad, mostafa.mahmoud, isak.edo, a.hadizadeh, ciaran.bannon}@mail.utoronto.ca, {anandj, pekhimenko}@cs.toronto.edu, moshovos@ece.utoronto.
arxiv-2010-08065.description: Abstract We present FPRaker , a processing element for composing training accelerators. FPRaker processes several floating-point multiply-accumulation operations concurrently and accumulates their result into a higher precision accumulator. FPRaker boosts performance and energy efficiency during training by taking advantage of the values that naturally appear during training.

arxiv-2011-12034.title: Weil–Petersson geodesics on the modular surface
arxiv-2011-12034.creator: Vaibhav Gadre
arxiv-2011-12034.description: Abstract . We consider the Weil–Petersson (WP) metric on the modular surface. We lift WP geodesics to the universal cover of the modular surface and analyse geometric properties of the lifts as paths in the hyperbolic metric on the universal cover.

arxiv-2110-09940.title: Learning Representations that Support Robust Transfer of Predictors
arxiv-2110-09940.creator: Yilun Xu, Tommi Jaakkola
arxiv-2110-09940.description: Abstract Ensuring generalization to unseen environments remains a challenge. Domain shift can lead to substantially degraded performance unless shifts are well-exercised within the available training environments. We introduce a simple robust estimation criterion – transfer risk – that is specifically geared towards optimizing transfer to new environments.

arxiv-2201-05282.title: Domain-shift adaptation via linear transformations
arxiv-2201-05282.creator: Roberto Vega, Russell Greiner
arxiv-2201-05282.description: Abstract A predictor, f A : X → Y f_{A}:X\to Y , learned with data from a source domain (A) might not be accurate on a target domain (B) when their distributions are different. Domain adaptation aims to reduce the negative effects of this distribution mismatch.

arxiv-2203-12877.title: Higher-order Context-free Session Types in System F
arxiv-2203-12877.creator: Diana Costa Andreia Mordido Diogo Poças Vasco T. Vasconcelos
arxiv-2203-12877.description: Abstract We present an extension of System F with higher-order context-free session types. The mixture of functional types with session types has proven to be a challenge for type equivalence formalization: whereas functional type equivalence is often rule-based, session type equivalence usually follows a semantic approach based on bisimulations.

arxiv-2205-09022.title: Field Distortion Model Based on Fredholm Integral
arxiv-2205-09022.creator: Yunqi Sun, Jianfeng Zhou
arxiv-2205-09022.description: Abstract Field distortion is widespread in imaging systems. If it cannot be measured and corrected well, it will affect the accuracy of photogrammetry. To this end, we proposed a general field distortion model based on Fredholm integration, which uses a reconstructed high-resolution reference point spread function (PSF) and two sets of 4-variable polynomials to describe an imaging system.

arxiv-2311-17184.description: Abstract The zero-age main sequence (ZAMS) is a critical phase for stellar angular momentum evolution, as stars transition from contraction-dominated spin-up to magnetic wind-dominated spin-down. We present the first robust observational constraints on rotation for FGK stars at ≈ 40 \approx 40 Myr.

arxiv-2408-10179.title: Three-stage Formation of Cap Carbonates after Marinoan Snowball Glaciation Consistent with Depositional Timescales and Geochemistry
arxiv-2408-10179.creator: Trent B. Thomas, David C. Catling
arxiv-2408-10179.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Trent B. Thomas, David C. Catling. At least two global “Snowball Earth” glaciations occurred during the Neoproterozoic Era (1000-538.8 million years ago). Post-glacial surface environments during this time are recorded in cap carbonates: layers of limestone or dolostone that directly overlie glacial deposits. Postulated environmental conditions that created the cap carbonates lack consensus largely because single hypotheses fail to explain the cap carbonates’ global mass, depositional timescales, and geochemistry of parent waters.

arxiv-2408-11107.title: Bounds on MLDR Codes Over ℤ p t \mathbb{Z}_{p^{t}}
arxiv-2408-11107.creator: Tim L. Alderson
arxiv-2408-11107.description: Abstract Upper bounds on the minimum Lee distance of codes that are linear over ℤ q \mathbb{Z}_{q} , q = p t q=p^{t} , p p prime are discussed. The bounds are Singleton like, depending on the length, rank, and alphabet size of the code.

arxiv-2502-14958.title: Incommensurate gapless ferromagnetism connecting competingsymmetry-enriched deconfined quantum phase transitions
arxiv-2502-14958.creator: Anthony Rey, Ömer M. Aksoy, Daniel P. Arovas, Claudio Chamon, Christopher Mudry
arxiv-2502-14958.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anthony Rey, Ömer M. Aksoy, Daniel P. Arovas, Claudio Chamon, Christopher Mudry. We present a scenario, in which a gapless extended phase serves as a “hub” connecting multiple symmetry-enriched deconfined quantum critical points. As a concrete example, we construct a lattice model with ℤ 2 × ℤ 2 × ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}^{\,}_{2}\times\mathbb{Z}^{\,}_{2}\times\mathbb{Z}^{\,}_{2} symmetry for quantum spin-1/2 degrees of freedom that realizes four distinct gapful phases supporting antiferromagnetic long-range order and one extended incommensurate gapless ferromagnetic phase.

arxiv-2510-19251.title: Synthesizability Prediction of Crystalline Structures with Structure-Aware Feature Learning and Uncertainty Quantification
arxiv-2510-19251.creator: Danial Ebrahimzadeh, Sarah Sharif, Yaser Mike Banad
arxiv-2510-19251.description: Abstract Predicting which hypothetical inorganic crystals can be experimentally realized remains a central challenge in accelerating materials discovery. SyntheFormer is a positive-unlabeled framework that learns synthesizability directly from crystal structure, combining Fourier-transformed crystal properties (FTCP) representation with structure-aware feature extraction, Random-Forest feature selection, and a compact deep MLP classifier.

pmc-11499234.creator: Hinnerk Schulz-Hildebrandt, Svetolik Spasic, Fang Hou, Kuan-Chung Ting, Shelley Batts, Guillermo Tearney, Konstantina M. Stankovic
pmc-11499234.description: Sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL) is caused by damage to the mechanosensory hair cells and auditory neurons of the cochlea.
